lead_headline: Five weekend restaurant leads surface—new HiFi bar Vaultaire debuts beneath La Forêt, RiNo coffee roastery opens brick-and-mortar, while foreclosure filings slip 9% week-over-week to 30

restaurant.blurb: 5 new leads over the weekend push active roster to 45 total (22 openings, 23 closures). Opening highlights: Vaultaire launched Saturday as subterranean HiFi listening bar beneath La Forêt on Broadway, Bad Rabbit Coffee transitions mobile caravan to RiNo brick-and-mortar in Cole, Chaton Bakery preps Aurora debut near H Mart Parker Commons. Closure ledger adds The Barn South Broadway Englewood signal—upscale American concept announced March 2025 now showing closure indicators before apparent launch. Weekend detections mirror ongoing Union Station hospitality build-out (Vaultaire, earlier C Burger/G-Que) against neighborhood attrition pattern. Active pipeline holds 22 opening leads versus 23 closures—roster nearly balanced after prior week's first net-negative tilt since February.

foreclosure.blurb: 30 new filings this week down 9% from prior week's 33—five-week descent from February's 49-filing peak continues (49→42→33→30), erasing earlier plateau signal. 39 auctions next seven days, aggregate $11.2M exposure. Single $2M+ property: Arapahoe's South Columbine Circle at $2.24M, followed by Weld's $618K Falcon Drive. Weld County maintains active lead at 391 cases, El Paso 375—exurban concentration unchanged. Four-week downtrend now clearly extended, not arrested—March filings running 39% below February peak. Trajectory suggests seasonal spring softening aligns with 2025 pattern, not distressed inventory surge. Weekly decline pace slowing (22% drop Week 1, 21% Week 2, 9% this week) implies descending approach toward March floor, likely 25-30 filing baseline before April cycle resets.

reputation.blurb: 1 mention over the weekend closes seven-day period at 44 citations across 11 sources—flat versus prior week's 43, settling into 43-45 range after launch volatility. Denver Post holds 36% share (16 pickups), Instagram contributes 7, social platforms combine for 15. Weekend lone detection: educational upein.edu.pe republishing 2021 Herd hires-departures archive content. Week's notables: Colorado Sun Littwin column on Post layoffs, oldest-Colorado-hotel ownership via Facebook, Mediterranean villa Post real estate listing. Google News RSS captures 98% discovery flow (43 of 44). Four-week pattern now clear: launch explosion (53) descended to 48, stabilized at 44-43 baseline—system equilibrium reached at ~6.3 daily mentions. Post partnership anchors referral consistency, social layer adds amplification breadth without viral dependency.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +3 since Friday (3 new, 0 canceled) lifts MTD to +19 (+1.3/day), 90-day cumulative to +83. Weekend delivered perfect retention—zero churn Saturday-Sunday after Friday's +1. Seven-day window now +17 net (24 new, 7 canceled), 2.4x improvement over prior week's +7 (29 new, 22 canceled). Cancellation compression drives gains: 1.0/day churn this week versus 3.1/day prior—retention tightening lifts net as much as acquisition. March's 1.3/day pace edges YTD's 1.2/day benchmark modestly upward. Two-week pattern: early-month volatility (Mar 2-5 swung +4 to −4) now stabilized into +1 to +6 daily range, with mid-month March 9 (+6) and March 12 (+4) peaks anchoring momentum. Trend sustainable if weekend zero-churn holds as baseline rather than anomaly.
